Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:10:1.hebrew: במה קונין - קנין חליפין דכתיב בקרא "שלף איש נעלו", מי שלף ונתן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:10:1.english: With what does one acquire - [Regarding] acquisition by exchange, as it is written in the verse, "a man drew off his shoe" [Ruth 4:7] — who drew [it] off and gave [it]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:11:1.english: That the one transferring ownership should acquire - the vessel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:1.hebrew: קא קני ארעא אגב גלימא - הנותן קרקע לחבירו בקנין סודר, והמקבל מתנה מושך הסודר מיד הנותן, ונקנה לו הקרקע עם הסודר במשיכת הסודר, שנקנה במשיכה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:1.english: He is acquiring land by means of a cloak - [When] one gives land to his fellow through an acquisition with a kerchief [kinyan sudar], and the recipient of a gift pulls the kerchief from the hand of the giver, the land is acquired by him along with the kerchief through the pulling of the kerchief, which is acquired through pulling.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:2.hebrew: א"כ - הוו להו קרקעות נקנין עם מטלטלין במשיכה, בדבר שהוא קנין למטלטלין ואינו קנין לקרקע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:2.english: If so - lands would be acquired together with movable property through pulling, by means of something that is an [effective] acquisition for movable property and is not an acquisition for land.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:3.hebrew: נכסים שאין להן אחריות נקנין עם נכסים שיש להן אחריות - בדבר שהוא קנין לקרקע ואינו קנין למטלטלין, כדקתני בכסף ובשטר ובחזקה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:12:3.english: Property that is not guaranteed is acquired together with property that is guaranteed - [That is,] through something that is a [valid] mode of acquisition for land and is not a mode of acquisition for movable property, as [the Mishnah] teaches: with money, with a document, and with taking possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:13:1.hebrew: מפיק לאפך פולסא דנורא - ניצוצות של אור, אשטנצל"ש, שהן עגולות כפולסא, דאמרי' לקמן: אסימון פולסא. ולשון שמתא קאמר ליה, שחשדתו בזו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:13:1.english: Bring out before you a pulsa of fire - Sparks of fire, estinceles [Old French], which are round like a pulsa, as we say later: "an asimon [is] a pulsa." And it is an expression of excommunication [that] he is saying to him, because you suspected him of this.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:13:2.hebrew: מי סברת - דאמר ליה אגב, שעל ידי משיכת הכלי שנקנה לו במשיכה יקנה לו הקרקע עם הכלי? אין אלו אלא כחליפין, כאילו זה מוסר לו חפץ אחר תחת קרקע. ומהו מסירתו? הנאת קבלתו ממנו מתנת הכלי, שחשבו לקבל ממנו מתנה נוח לו, כאילו נותן לו זה הקונה מתנה רבה, וגמר נותן ומקנה לו הקרקע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:13:2.english: Do you maintain - that he said to him [that the land is acquired] agav [along with the vessel], [meaning] that through pulling the vessel, which is acquired by him through pulling, he acquires the land along with the vessel? [Rather,] this is nothing other than like chalifin [barter], as if this one [the buyer] hands over to him another object in exchange for land. And what is his handing over? The pleasure of his accepting from him the gift of the vessel; for [the fact that] he esteemed him [enough] to accept a gift from him is pleasing to him, as if this buyer is giving him a great gift, and the giver resolves and transfers ownership of the land to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:14:1.hebrew: גאולה זו מכירה - שמכר לו מכירה גמורה בדמים, ולא קיבל מעות, ובאין לקיים דברי מכירתן על ידי קנין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:14:1.english: "Redemption" — that is a sale - [This refers to a case] where one sold [something] to another in a complete sale for money, and did not receive the money, and they come to confirm the terms of their sale by means of an act of acquisition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:14:2.english: That is exchange - For he exchanges this vessel for the object opposite it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:16:1.english: They did not teach - That one effects an acquisition except with a vessel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:16:2.english: But with produce - Anything that is not a vessel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:16:3.english: No - Even if [it is] worth a lot.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:17:1.english: To confirm all matters - To confirm [a transaction] with any item.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:17:2.english: That [phrase], “to confirm all matters” - [means] redemption and exchange [are effected] with a shoe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:1:1.english: And his fellow has a claim of exploitation against him - If the coins do not equal the value of the item, [in] that they fall short [by] a sixth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:2:1.hebrew: כחליפין דמי - ולקמיה פריך, והא אין מטבע נעשה חליפין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:2:1.english: Is similar to an exchange - And later [the Gemara] asks: But a coin cannot be made [an object of] exchange!

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:2:2.english: Because he says, "Sell me" - [This is] language of sale, and not language of exchange.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:2:3.english: Behold, he said - That he acquires [the item] without pulling [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:2:4.english: Because he says, "Sell me" - [This is] the language of sale and not the language of exchange.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:1.hebrew: פשיטא לן דמים ואין מקפיד עליהן - נתן לו מעות או חפץ בשביל חפץ אחר בתורת דמים, ולא הקפיד עליהן לראות אם ישנן כדי שויין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:1.english: It is obvious to us: money, and he is not particular about them - [Where] he gave him coins or an object for another object as money, and was not particular about them to see whether they are equal to its value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:2.hebrew: חליפין ומקפיד עליהן - נתן לו חפץ בחפץ בתורת חליפין, לקנות כדין קנין שקונין בסודר, וזה מקפיד לראות שיהא הסודר שוה כל כך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:2.english: Exchange, and he is particular about them - [If] he gave him an item for an item by way of exchange, to acquire [it] according to the law of acquisition by which one acquires with a kerchief, and this one is particular to see that the kerchief is worth such-and-such [an amount].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:3.hebrew: מהו - מי קנו תרוייהו במשיכה דחד מינייהו, או דלמא הואיל והקפיד עליהם הרי הן כדמים, והוי להו מעות ואין קונות עד שימשוך גם השני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:3:3.english: What [is the law] - Do both of them acquire through the pulling of one of them, or perhaps, since he was particular about them, they are like monetary value, and they are [treated as] money and do not acquire until the second [party] also pulls [his item]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:4:1.english: Your cow, why - did you bring [it] to the market?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:7:1.english: Rava said: Is exchange - [i.e., the exchange] of the verse.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:7:2.hebrew: בשופטני עסקינן - דלא קפדי לדעת שיהו שוות קצת דמים, שייטב בעיניו לתת לו את שלו כנגדו, ואפי' הכי קאמר קרא דקנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:7:2.english: Are we dealing with fools - Who are not particular to know that [the items] are worth some value, such that it would be pleasing in his eyes to give him his own in exchange for it, and even so the verse says that he acquires?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:8:1.english: Let us say that Rav Huna holds, etc. - For he gave the reason for his statement, because they are like exchange.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:1.hebrew: סבר לה כרבי יוחנן - כלומר, אין מטבע נעשה חליפין, והני לאו חליפין נינהו אלא דמים, דהא מכור לי קאמר. ודמים כי האי גוונא קנו בלא משיכה, כחליפין דקנין סודר, משום דזביני דלא שכיח נינהו, וכרבי יוחנן כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:1.english: He holds in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan - That is to say, a coin cannot be [used as] exchange, and these [coins] are not exchange, but rather purchase money, for he said, "Sell [it] to me." And purchase money in such a case acquires without pulling, like the exchange of acquisition by a kerchief, because it is an uncommon [form of] sale, and [it is] in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:2.hebrew: אתון הכי מתניתו לה - לדרב הונא, דמספקא לכו אי סבר ליה מטבע נעשה חליפין ואם לאו, ודחיתו דחוי בעלמא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:2.english: You teach it in this manner - Regarding Rav Huna, for you are uncertain whether he holds [that] a coin becomes [an instrument of] exchange or not, and you pushed [it] off with a mere deflection.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:3.hebrew: אנן - בהדיא מתנינן רב הונא בהדי הנך רבנן דלעיל (בבא מציעא דף מו.), "וכן אמר רב הונא" כו', ולא מספקא לן הכא מידי, דודאי טעמיה משום דס"ל כרבי יוחנן הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 47a:9:3.english: We - [We] explicitly teach Rav Huna['s ruling] together with those Sages [mentioned] above (Bava Metzia 46a), "And likewise Rav Huna said," etc., and we have no doubt here at all, for certainly his reason is because he holds in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:12:1.hebrew: בכליו של מקנה - דוקא בכליו של מקנה ולא בכליו של קונה, דהא מקרא יליף לקמן. ואי לוי סבר אין מטבע נעשה חליפין וכן פירי, היינו טעמא: דבעי הנאת קבלת דבר חשוב דומיא דנעל, ולא מטבע ופירי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:12:1.english: With the utensil of the one transferring ownership - Specifically with the utensil of the one transferring ownership and not with the utensil of the one acquiring [it], for he derives [this] from a verse below. And if Levi holds [that] a coin cannot be used for symbolic exchange (chalifin), and likewise produce, this is the reason: because he requires the benefit of receiving a significant object similar to a shoe, and not a coin or produce.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:14:1.hebrew: גאולה זו מכירה וכן הוא אומר אם לא יגאל ונמכר - וקשה לר"ת, דאדרבה פסוק זה מוכיח דגאולה אינה מכירה. אלא גרס "לא יגאל", דכתיב במעשר בהמה, ואמרינן בפ' כל פסולי המוקדשין (בכורות דף לב.) דהאי "לא יגאל" — "לא ימכר" הוא, דאינו נמכר לא חי ולא שחוט. ומפרש ר"ת: "גאולה זו מכירה" — ולרבי יוחנן גאולה בכסף, ולר"ל במשיכה. "תמורה זו חליפין" — של שוה בשוה, דמהני לכ"ע אפי' בפירי. "לקיים כל דבר" — לרבות אינו שוה בשוה: למר אף במטבע ופירי, ולמר דוקא בכלי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:14:1.english: "Redemption; that is a sale. And likewise it says: If it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold" - And this is difficult for Rabbeinu Tam, for on the contrary, this verse proves that redemption is not a sale. Rather, [Rabbeinu Tam] reads [the text as]: "It shall not be redeemed," which is written regarding the animal tithe, and we say in the chapter Kol Pesulei HaMukdashin (Bekhorot 32a) that this [phrase] "it shall not be redeemed" means "it shall not be sold," as it may not be sold, neither alive nor slaughtered. And Rabbeinu Tam explains: "Redemption; that is a sale" — and according to Rabbi Yochanan, redemption is [effected] with money, and according to Reish Lakish, with pulling [meshikhah]. "Substitution; that is exchange" — [meaning an exchange] of equal value for equal value, which is effective according to everyone, even with produce. "To confirm all matters" — to include [an exchange of] unequal value: according to the one [opinion], even with coins and produce, and according to the other [opinion], specifically with a utensil.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:16:1.hebrew: קונים בכלי אף על פי שאין בו שוה פרוטה - וא"ת: בפ' כל שעה (פסחים דף לב: ושם ד"ה ואין) אמרינן גבי "ונתן לכהן את הקדש" דאין נתינה פחות משוה פרוטה, וה"נ כתיב "ונתן לרעהו"! וי"ל דהתם הוי תשלומין שגזל ההקדש, הלכך ליתנהו פחות משוה פרוטה, כמו גבי מעילה דהוי תשלומין; אבל נתינת מנעל הוא לרעהו, ולא נתינת ממון. וכן "ונתן בידה" דגט — הוי נתינת גט ולא נתינת ממון, כדאמר פ' שני דגיטין (דף כ. ושם ד"ה דלמא): כתבו על איסורי הנאה — כשר. וכן (חולין דף קלז:) נתינת תרומה, דחטה אחת פוטרת את הכרי. וגבי סיכה, דכתיב "ואשר יתן", ואיכא למ"ד (כריתות דף ו:) דהוי בכל שהוא אע"ג דמעילה היא — היינו משום דכתיב סיכה, דמשמע בכל שהוא; ומ"ד בכזית — סבר כרבנן דאבא שאול, דאמרי נתינה בכזית, כזר שאכל תרומה. וגבי לבונה, דבעינן כזית בפרק כל המנחות (מנחות דף נט: ושם ס. ד"ה מי) — משום דשני מלשון שימה דאתחיל ביה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:16:1.english: One can acquire [property] by [using] a vessel, even if it does not have the value of a perutah - And if you will ask: In the chapter Kol Sha'ah (Pesachim 32b, and there s.v. Ve'ein), we say regarding [the verse] "and he shall give the holy thing to the priest" that "giving" cannot be less than the value of a perutah, and here too it is written "and he gave [it] to his fellow"! One can answer that there it is restitution [for] having stolen from consecrated property; therefore, [restitution] is not [made with] less than the value of a perutah, just as regarding me'ilah, which is restitution. However, the giving of a shoe is [simply] "to his fellow," and not a giving of money. And similarly, "and he puts [it] in her hand" regarding a get is the giving of a get and not a giving of money, as it says in the second chapter of Gittin (20a, and there s.v. Dilma): [If] he wrote it on items from which benefit is forbidden, it is valid. And similarly (Chullin 137b) [regarding] the giving of terumah, where a single grain of wheat exempts the [entire] pile. And regarding anointing [with the anointing oil], where it is written "and whoever puts [it upon a stranger]," and there is an opinion (Keritot 6b) that it applies to any minute amount even though it is me'ilah — that is because "anointing" is written [there], which implies any minute amount; and the one who says [the liability is for] an olive's bulk holds like the Rabbis of Abba Shaul, who say that "giving" is [measured by] an olive's bulk, like a non-priest who ate terumah. And regarding frankincense, where we require an olive's bulk in the chapter Kol HaMenachot (Menachot 59b, and there 60a s.v. Mi) — [that is] because [Scripture] changed from the expression of "placing" with which it began.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:17:1.hebrew: לאפוקי חצי רמון וחצי אגוז דלא - וסודר דג' על ג', דאמר לעיל פ"ק (בבא מציעא דף ז.) דכמאן דפסיק דמי, חשיב דבר מסוים:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:17:1.english: To exclude half a pomegranate and half a nut, which cannot [effect a symbolic exchange] - And a kerchief of three by three [fingerbreadths], which [the Gemara] says above in the first chapter (Bava Metzia 7a) is considered as though it were severed, is considered a complete item.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:7:1.hebrew: כל חליפין מיקפד קפדי - שיהו שוין קצת, ולפעמים שיהו שוין כמו החפץ גופיה; ואפילו כשאינו שוה כחפץ שכנגדו, קנה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:7:1.english: [In] every [case of] exchange, they are particular - [That is, they are particular] that [the items] be worth something, and sometimes that they be worth as much as the object itself; and [nevertheless,] even when it is not worth as much as the object opposite it, he acquires.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:9:1.hebrew: רב הונא סבר כר' יוחנן - ומיירי בתורת דמים, ולעיל ה"פ: והני דמים, כיון דלא שכיחי, כחליפין דמו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 47a:9:1.english: Rav Huna holds in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan - And [the case] deals with [an acquisition] by way of purchase money, and above, this is [the Gemara's] explanation: And this purchase money, since it is uncommon, is like [an item of] exchange.
